title: Integral coefficient ring, derived category, and reduction data
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, chosen uniformizer $\pi_E$ and the topology of its absolute value [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $A_E=\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ be the condensed ring $S\mapsto C(S,\mathcal O_E)$ of continuous functions on profinite sets [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], regarded as a commutative ring object of $\Sh(*_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Ab)$. For $n\geq0$ let $\underline{\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^n}$ be the condensed ring of the finite quotient $\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^n\mathcal O_E$ with the quotient topology, an $A_E$-module object through the quotient map [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]; for $n=0$ it is zero. For every scheme $X$, with small pro-\'etale site $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $A_{E,X}=p_X^*A_E$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and let $D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},A_E)$ be the unbounded derived category [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] of $A_{E,X}$-module objects of $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Ab)$. For $n\geq0$ the derived reduction $R_{X,n}$ is the endofunctor $K\mapsto K\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{A_{E,X}}p_X^*(\underline{\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^n})$ of $D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},A_E)$, the quotient placed in degree zero [def-sfb-derived-tensor-modules]. The Lean declarations of these three notions are those recorded with [det-pe-derived-nakayama-resolution]; this node gives them the canonical names `integralCoefficientRing`, `integralDerived` and `integralReductionFunctor`.
